newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash crudes remain weak on sour grade sales.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash crudes remain weak on sour grade sales.

text.p: U.S. cash crude grades remained weak heading into the later stages of Tuesday business, deflated notably in the sour grades, traders said.
Large quantities of sour crude either headed to or in the U.S. Gulf worked to depress West Texas Sour/Midland and Eugene Island barrels.
At the same time, the outright price of benchmark April West Texas Intermediate/Cushing climned higher, posting advances of more 35 cents per barrel to $20.60-70 a barrel.
The April/May spread weakened only a shade from late Monday, moving to around 20 cts.
